{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Overloaded Cycle 1 Day 1 visit",
      "quote": "Treatment Cycle 1a (Day 1) | 2 (Day 1) | 3 (Day 1) | 4+ (Day 1)",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Cycle 1 Day 1 includes many procedures (physical exam, labs, PROs, pain, etc.) in addition to treatment administration, which may be burdensome for patients and sites.",
      "fix": "Consider moving some assessments (e.g., PROs) to a separate visit or allow completion prior to the visit."
    },
    {
      "title": "ECG only at screening",
      "quote": "ECG | X |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "ECG is only performed at screening, but the protocol mentions ECG assessments in Section 8.2.3.2 without specifying frequency; this may be insufficient for cardiac safety monitoring, especially with docetaxel.",
      "fix": "Add ECG at specified on-treatment timepoints or clarify that it is only at screening."
    },
    {
      "title": "Concomitant medications only at screening",
      "quote": "Concomitant medications | X |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "Concomitant medications are only recorded at screening, but they should be collected throughout the study to capture changes and potential interactions.",
      "fix": "Add concomitant medication collection at each treatment visit and follow-up."
    },
    {
      "title": "CT/MRI only at screening",
      "quote": "CT/MRIf | X |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "Disease assessments (CT/MRI) are only at screening, but efficacy evaluations require periodic imaging to assess response and progression.",
      "fix": "Add imaging at specified intervals (e.g., every 6-8 weeks) per protocol."
    },
    {
      "title": "Vital assessments only at LTFU",
      "quote": "Vital Assessments |  |  |  |  |  |  | X",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Vital assessments appear only at long-term follow-up, which is inconsistent with the need for ongoing safety monitoring during treatment.",
      "fix": "Clarify what 'Vital Assessments' includes and add them at treatment visits."
    },
    {
      "title": "PGIC only at Cycle 3 Day 1",
      "quote": "PRO/QOL assessments: PGIC |  |  |  | X |  |  |",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "PGIC is only at Cycle 3 Day 1, but it is typically collected at multiple post-baseline timepoints to assess change over time.",
      "fix": "Consider adding PGIC at later cycles or follow-up."
    },
    {
      "title": "Thyroid function tests not at Cycle 2",
      "quote": "Thyroid function tests | X |  | X | X | X | X |",
      "page": 31,
      "section": "Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Thyroid function tests are missing at Cycle 2 Day 1, which may be an oversight given they are done at other cycles.",
      "fix": "Add thyroid function tests at Cycle 2 Day 1."
    },
    {
      "title": "PROs completed before other assessments",
      "quote": "The PRO questionnaires completed in the clinic should be completed by the subject prior to any other clinical assessments and before receiving any study medications.",
      "page": 88,
      "section": "8.2.2.1.3 Clinical Outcome Assessments",
      "category": "advisory",
      "severity": "advisory",
      "explanation": "This requirement may be hard to implement in busy clinic days, especially if patients are late or have many procedures.",
      "fix": "Allow PROs to be completed in waiting room or via electronic device before visit."
    }
  ]
}
